thread:
maria.g: quick heads-up — starting lyra-9b-qlora onboarding to the catalog. weights landed at s3://redwood-models/lyra/9b/qlora-v2/ and spm model at the same prefix. can ppl sanity-check tokenizer + model config before we kick off large perf runs? :eyes:
sam.k: confirmed I can access the weights. maria, what config are we using for special tokens? last time qlora variants had a shifted BOS/CLS mapping that broke our wrapper.
jin.h: poked at the spm file — it's SentencePiece with <s> id=1 and </s> id=2, unk=0. our tokenizer wrapper expects bos_token_id=0 which will misalign logits. quick fix is to set model_config.json: 
```
{"bos_token_id": 1, "eos_token_id": 2, "unk_token_id": 0}
```
or set tokenizer.set_special_tokens({"bos_token":"<s>","eos_token":"</s>"}) at load. tested locally, small prompt encodes cleanly after that.
olive.p: thanks jin. for perf runs, what's the target seq len and batch sweep? we should run warmup + stable window and capture p50/p95. also aware of KV cache pacifying on qlora memory paths.
maria.g: plan — run micro smoke on dev A100 (seq 128) then full sweep on perf cluster. sweep: batch sizes [1,2,4,8], seq lenses [64,128,512], 30 iters warmup + 100 samples. collect p50/p95/p99 and token/s throughput. deploy config I'm using: 
```yaml
model: lyra-9b-qlora-v2
weights: s3://redwood-models/lyra/9b/qlora-v2/
quant: none
kv_cache: enabled
max_length: 512
```
sam.k: running quick tokenizer smoke now. command I used: 
```bash
python -c "from tokenizers import Tokenizer; t=Tokenizer.from_file('spm.model'); print(t.encode('hello world').ids)"
```
output before config patch: [4, 23, 9] (weird leading 4) after applying bos_token_id=1 -> [1, 4, 23, 9] which looks correct. filing a tiny PR to set defaults in our catalog metadata. :+1:
jin.h: one more gotcha — qlora weight layout uses replicated kv ordering for past_key_values, perf runner needs the flag --kv-order=replicated otherwise memory indexing is off and you get a 1.5x slowdown. add that to the perf config.
perf-bot: scheduled micro-run on perf-a100-2, id=run_2003456789_1. expected duration ~12m. will post summaries when done. :robot_face:
maria.g: for the large sweep I’ll request dedicated slot Friday morning. can someone review the PR that pins bos/eos in catalog metadata? link: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/+/PR-3141 — small change, tests added. pinging @sam.k and @jin.h for quick review. :rocket:
sam.k: reviewing now, will comment by EOD.
olive.p: once perf-bot posts numbers, I can add them to the catalog entry (cost estimates + recommended batch sizes). initial guess: batch=2 is the best latency/throughput sweet spot for seq=128 but we'll see. :thumbsup:
maria.g: thanks all — follow-ups: sam/jin review PR, perf-bot results -> olive annotates catalog, I'll book Friday slot for full sweep. closing thread after results. :checkered_flag:
